frequency_question: Among all formal reviews of recognized accrediting bodies by the federal oversight agency, how often does the review result in the total revocation of recognition rather than renewal or extension?
membership_rule: Includes any formal periodic or triggered review by the federal education oversight department regarding a national professional or educational accrediting agency's recognition status. Excludes voluntary relinquishments of recognition.
window: Within a standard administrative review cycle of up to 36 months.

cases.name: Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools (ACICS) 2016 review
National Association of Schools of Public Affairs and Administration 2017 review

coverage_note: 8 named major institutional and programmatic reviews; believed roughly 40-50 total agency recognition cycles occurred in this timeframe, making revocations rare events.
known_gaps: Comprehensive enumeration of all minor programmatic accreditor reviews is difficult to assemble from public administrative summaries, though major ones are well cataloged.
validity_reason: Administrative law and the statutory framework governing agency recognition changes slowly through legislation or broad regulatory overhauls.
